subject: STABLE encode-cpu-opus: async pipeline creation (approved safety rule) + C6p corpus fed; gate-green 15:31-15:45; HEAVY RELEASE
body:
GATES 15:31-15:45 (shared tree)
- run_host_tests: all passed, including the iOS strict link.
- CA: PASS. Render: 32. Async: 7/7 (lowering-opus's B1 check included).
- Integration: only the known CA pass failure (required_failures=2). native compute OK again.

ASYNC PIPELINE CREATION
render_pipeline.inc fenced block 'encode-cpu-opus: asynchronous pipeline creation', plus one resolve line in render_encoder.inc setRenderPipelineState.
- Rule:
  - newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor returns a placeholder at once ONLY when the descriptor's build-independent description built successfully before (the ledger).
  - The ledger lives in memory plus pso-known-good-v1.txt in the pipeline cache directory. It survives builds and compiler changes. Every successful synchronous build adds to it.
  - Everything else builds synchronously as before, so nil + NSError is unchanged.
- Workers: the real build is unchanged teguBuildRenderPipeline, run on a COPY of the descriptor on up to 2 workers at QOS utility (dispatch global queue), each with its own autorelease pool.
- At the first bind (setRenderPipelineState):
  - still queued: the encoding thread builds it itself (never slower than sync);
  - building: it waits;
  - built: the real pipeline is bound;
  - failed: the placeholder stays inert (TEGU_PIPELINE_ASYNC_FAILED; its draws are dropped and logged, the command is NOT failed).
- Teardown cancels queued builds or waits for running ones; no worker-side ObjC retain.
- Kill switch: NORD2_METAL_ASYNC_PSO=0.
- Device line: TEGU_PERF_PSO_ASYNC with async, sync_unknown, built, build_ms, ready_at_draw, built_at_draw, built_at_draw_ms, waits, wait_ms, inert, known.
- Host test, frame_bench FB_APSO=1 (host builds have no worker threads, by design):
  - 3 placeholders created (the 4th descriptor is not eligible).
  - Built at first draw (at_draw=2), or drained first (built=3, at_draw=0).
  - Every built pipeline equals the synchronous one byte for byte (genericCompile, module digests); frame status 4; no ASan/UBSan reports.

C6P CORPUS
- pipeline_corpus.py scan of c6p-test/ui60-usb/xnu-live.log with the C6p package bundle (Nord2Metal 6bf75694).
- 172 verified descriptions, 343 Mali variants. build/pipeline-corpus/corpus.txt went from 629 to 848 records.
- The next build_pipeline_pack run includes them.
